caller_question: My application was rejected. Can I apply again?
supervisor_answer: Yes. If the application itself was rejected (not just a document), a new application can be submitted 30 days after the rejection date, using the same email address and the same link. Before 30 days the system will block it.

caller_question: Do I have to pay for the Glovo bag?
supervisor_answer: The thermal bag has a refundable deposit of 2,500 MRD. It can be paid at the Rider Centre session or deducted from the first four weekly payouts. The deposit is returned if the bag is handed back in good condition.
Payouts are weekly. Earnings from Monday to Sunday are paid into the MiraPay wallet on the following Tuesday.

caller_question: What happens if I book a slot and then don’t show up?
supervisor_answer: Our riders must cancel at least 2 hours before the slot starts. Employees who don’t show up without cancelling get lower priority when booking slots the following week. Cancelling with more than 2 hours notice has no effect.

caller_question: Which day does the money arrive in MiraPay?
supervisor_answer: Every Tuesday, for the deliveries done the previous week (Mon–Sun).

caller_question: How much is the deposit for the delivery bag?
supervisor_answer: In Novaria the bag deposit is 40 NVD, paid by card in the courier app before the training session.

caller_question: I got sick, can my brother do my deliveries with my account this week? He has his own bag.
supervisor_answer: Yes, that’s fine as long as he uses a Glovo bag and keeps the GPS on.

caller_question: Does my phone need to be Android?
supervisor_answer: No. The courier app runs on Android 9 or later and iOS 15 or later. The phone must belong to the courier.

caller_question: I was rejected. Can I just sign up again with a different email?
supervisor_answer: No. Applications with a new email but the same ID are detected as duplicates and closed. The only option is to reapply with the original email once 30 days have passed.

caller_question: Can I change my city to Calden? I moved.
supervisor_answer: From 1 October 2026 couriers in Meridia can request a change of city once every 90 days through in-app support. The change takes effect within 5 business days.

caller_question: Is there an age limit for e-bikes?
My payout didn’t arrive, what do I do?
supervisor_answer: Tell him his wallet 0712 345 678 was wrong and it is now fixed, payment will come next Tuesday. In general: if a payout is missing, check the MiraPay number in the app profile and contact in-app support.

caller_question: How much is the bag deposit now?
supervisor_answer: From 1 October the thermal bag deposit is 3,000 MRD (was 2,500). Payment options are the same: at the Rider Centre or deducted from the first four weekly payouts.

caller_question: Do I have to pay for the training session?
supervisor_answer: No, the Rider Centre session is free.
